question: William S. Hart Union High School District Governing Board, Trustee Area 2, November 8, 2022 General Election
answer: Trustee Area 2 was on the Nov 8, 2022 ballot and contested. Per the LA County RR/CC Final Official Statement of Votes Cast (election 4300, p.169), incumbent Bob Jensen won with 11,639 votes over Andrew Taban's 5,736 (66.99% / 33.01%; registration 36,496; ballots cast 21,104). RR/CC certified the results on 2022-12-05. Jensen holds the seat with a 2022-2026 term per hartdistrict.org. Our box election data has no Hart 2022 contests at all; the gap is in our data.
